messages:
alice.chen: Heads-up: external pen test scheduled for Mon 2026-05-18. They asked for scope, RBAC diffs, audit-log retention, and KMS access matrix by EOD Friday. I attached the intake doc (drive link). Can infra/security owners confirm what we can share and the retest window we should promise?

ben.patel: Thanks Alice. I'll take lead on intake + vuln triage. Quick checklist: scope confirmation, evidence export path, read-only access for testers, service account creds rotation plan, and retest SLA.

maria.gomez: For KMS: we can provide read-only decryption via short-lived IAM role, but we cannot export raw key material. If testers need to validate envelope encryption, we can spin a test key in a sandbox project and mirror policies. Also: rotating keys during remediation window will break some async jobs — will need a maintenance window.

ben.patel: Noted re: rotation. Please add expected blast radius in the sandbox plan. Also, request from testers: audit logs for the last 90 days from the following services: auth, kms, storage, and model-serving. Is 90d retention feasible?

maria.gomez: 90d is fine for auth + storage; model-serving logs are on our short-retention cluster (30d). We can export model-serving logs to long-term bucket for the duration of the engagement. There will be a small egress/cost impact.

jonathan.sre: Oncall here. If we expose read-only access or create test SACs, we want a rollback recipe. Suggest: create SACs in `sec-pen-test` org folder, bind minimal roles, set TTL 48h, and document revocation steps. I'll own runbook updates.

ben.patel: Good. Also: RBAC diffs. We should provide a delta of recent privilege changes (last 6 months) for the target services. Alice, can you export the audit of IAM policy changes for those projects? If not, I can request from cloud-admin.

alice.chen: I can pull the IAM change logs and share a redacted CSV by tomorrow morning.

sec-bot: vuln-tracker: New ticket created -> VS-2026-1842. Tags: pen-test, intake, needs-evidence. Assignee: ben.patel.

ben.patel: Created a remediation tracking sheet (link). Columns: vuln id, severity, owner, status, poc, evidence link, retest-ready flag. Please start adding owners asap. We'll set weekly syncs until retest.

maria.gomez: Quick note about KMS integration tests: sample curl to exercise decryption via short-lived role:
```bash
TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences=https://kms.googleapis.com)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://kms.googleapis.com/v1/projects/pen-test/locations/global/keyRings/test/cryptoKeys/testKey:decrypt \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```
Replace ciphertext with tester payload. We'll provide a sandbox key.

jonathan.sre: Add to runbook: if testers trigger high error rates on model-serving, auto-fallback to readonly cache and alert SRE. I added a pager flow to the runbook doc.

ben.patel: Proposed retest window: 7 days after initial remediation push, with evidence uploaded 24h before retest. Agree?

alice.chen: Sounds good. I'll confirm with procurement/legal about NDA scope to ensure we can share logs.

maria.gomez: One more: for evidence handoff, we'll provide a signed manifest that lists artifacts (log export path, screenshots, key IDs used). Helps audit.

ben.patel: Action items: 1) Alice: IAM change CSV by tomorrow. 2) Maria: sandbox KMS key + log-export instructions. 3) Jonathan: create SAC runbook and pager rules. 4) Ben: populate tracking sheet and assign owners. I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday 10:30am.

alice.chen: +1 for Friday. Adding calendar invite now.

jonathan.sre: If anyone needs help scripting the evidence export, ping me, I can share a small python snippet to pull logs and checksum them.

ben.patel: Thanks team. We'll aim to keep remediation slots small and scoped so retest is quick. I'll update VS-2026-1842 with the timeline after Alice's CSV.
